einzeiler: Ben Nemtin on mental health, bucket lists and overcoming pressure.
kurzfassung: Ben Nemtin discusses his journey through anxiety, depression, and performance pressure. He explains the origin of The Buried Life movement and the process of pursuing bucket-list goals. Additionally, he explores how helping others and uncovering personal objectives can lead to a life with fewer regrets.

beschreibung:
Ben Nemtin’s mental health unraveled under the pressure to succeed in school and rugby, until anxiety and depression left him unable to function. His recovery started with one choice: surround himself with people who inspired him. That mindset shift led Ben and three friends to create The Buried Life, a mission to pursue 100 bucket-list dreams while helping strangers achieve theirs. Along the way, he discovered how purpose, accountability, and action can move us through fear. In this episode, Ben shares the keys at the intersection of entrepreneurship, mental health, and personal fulfillment: how to uncover buried goals, pursue what truly matters, and build a life with fewer regrets.

In this episode, Hala and Ben will discuss:

(49:25) Write Your Goals, Live Without Regret

Ben Nemtin is the co-founder of The Buried Life movement and the #1 New York Times bestselling author of What Do You Want to Do Before You Die? He is also the author of The Bucket List Journal and starred in MTV’s hit reality series The Buried Life. Ben has been ranked among the world’s top motivational speakers by Global Gurus and has delivered keynotes for organizations including Amazon, Microsoft, FedEx, and Verizon.
